text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Inari One finished all of her 
training for today—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"You're telling me that's it?! Didn't you 
get the portion wrong?! I've still got 
plenty of energy to burn!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Don't be so stingy, let me run some 
more!
choice_data_list:
Any more than this will lead to 
overworking, so...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis! Don't be stingy, let me run some 
more!"
choice_data_list:
Any more than this will lead to 
overworking, so...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! A true Edo kid never saves 
yesterday's legs for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Inari, Inari! Are you still running too?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey Turbo. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo still has energy left, so Turbo's 
gonna go run!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Running until you're totally empty feels 
so good! Just the other day, I ran until I 
dropped and fell right asleep on the spot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Obsessing over details is just uncool! 
More than that, your determination to see 
it through is awesome! Turbo, you've got 
the true spirit of an Edokko!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm gonna go run a bit myself! 
I can't just sit here quietly while Turbo 
gets to look all cool!
choice_data_list:
As a Trainer, there's no way I can just 
sit by and stay quiet!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright! Look at you, talking sense!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Turbo! How about we do a tandem 
training run?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You got it! Let's do this! Game on!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hey, Turbo! Get back here, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Inari One kept on running with 
Twin Turbo until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Well said, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Well said, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That dedication to staying true to 
yourself is admirable! You must be pretty 
darn confident in your way of thinking!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Seeing your fighting spirit, I'll 
let you off for today's special training!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're not gonna run? And here I 
thought we could finally face off! Boring, 
boring, bo-ring!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Instead, let's head over to a sweet shop 
and have a dango-eating contest! Sweet 
stuff's the best thing for a tired body!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You're on! I accept your dango challenge!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, cute as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One said so with a satisfied look 
and went out together with Twin Turbo.
